Hi Priya — great, thanks for confirming Tue 09:30 PST.

Quick checklist from my side for the load run:
- Sample prompts (10–15 examples) covering short instruction, multi-turn, and long-context extraction
- Expected concurrency / QPS (baseline & peak) — e.g., 5 qps baseline, 20 qps peak
- Token distribution (percent short/medium/long) — helps decide KV cache and batching profile
- Any data masking rules we should respect during prompt ingestion

If you can drop files into the shared Drive folder, I’ll pre-config the load harness and share the run playbook.

One quick note: if you need an extra quota bump for the initial burst I can request a temporary Hosted quota increase to avoid early throttling during the load test. Let me know the numbers and I’ll push it.

See you Tuesday — Ben
